use.roof: dark brown wooden shingles (tone 0 = violet-black gaps and outlines, 6 = sun-bleached worn shingle)
use.tile: red clay roof tiles of the original Beodeul houses (code-made roof face; 0-1 violet gaps, 3 shaded tile, 5 lit tile, 6 highlight)
use.moss: moss flecks on the roof and weeds at the wall foot, a few pixels only
use.plaster: whitewashed plaster panels (0-1 = violet-grey shadow, 2-3 = stains and speckle, 4-6 = lit plaster)
use.timber: dark oak frame beams, posts, braces, barge boards, door planks
use.stone: rubble-stone ground floor (0-2 = deep violet mortar joints, 3-7 = individual stones from shaded to lit)
use.board: lighter sawn boards: balcony, stair treads, shutters, sign boards, crates
use.glass: window glass (0-3 dark panes, 4-5 reflection streak, 6-7 glints) - also the shadow tone under eaves is glass:2/stone:0 violet
use.iron: wrought iron hinges, brackets, chimney cap, chimney stone, smoke (6-8)
use.accent: 0-2 red (geraniums, a painted door, sign emblem), 3-4 orange/yellow (flowers, lantern, brass), 5 leaf green, 6 teal glint - a few pixels only
use.shake: old wooden roof shakes gone green-brown with moss (0 = black gaps, 6 = sun-bleached shake)
use.log: dark weathered log / horizontal plank wall
use.plank: vertical board-and-batten planks (gables, upper walls, sheds), a little warmer
use.fstone: grey field stone: footing, chimney, retaining walls (0-2 dark joints, 3-7 stones from shaded to lit)
use.trim: dark green painted trim: eave fascia, shutters, door frames
use.frame: pale painted window frames and sills
use.cream: pale cream sandstone masonry of the house walls
use.buff: darker grey-buff harbour rubble: ground courses, bases, steps, chimneys (0-2 dark joints, 3-7 stones from shaded to lit)
use.teal: dark teal painted woodwork: doors, shutters
use.pale: pale dressed stone: window surrounds, arches, sills, quoins
use.slate: violet roof slates (0 = black gaps, 6 = sun-lit slate edge)
use.violet: violet painted woodwork and cloth: window frames, doors, banners
use.tealroof: blue-green (teal) painted roof shingles (0 = black gaps, 6 = sun-lit edge)
use.blue: blue dyed awning cloth (0 shadow fold, 4 sun-lit)
use.green: green dyed awning cloth (0 shadow fold, 4 sun-lit)
